title: Rotations in space do not commute
lede: Each press turns the object a quarter turn about a fixed axis. The left copy applies your moves in the order pressed, the right copy in reverse order. Arrows are the fixed x, y, z axes.
notice: After x then y, the left copy and the right copy end in different orientations. Check which face points toward you.
Press x twice, or y twice: the two copies agree, because turns about the same axis do commute.
The readout is computed from exact integer rotation matrices, not from the animation.
hint: Press the x and y buttons in any order. Drag to look around.
